chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, who said:

Abu Abdillah عليه السلام was asked, while I was present, about a woman who sees yellowish discharge. He said: "Whatever occurs before menstruation is from menstruation, and whatever occurs after menstruation is not from it."

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman being asked about in the legal ruling

ai.seo_question: Does yellowish discharge before or after menstruation count as hayd in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding yellowish discharge seen by a woman in relation to menstruation. It states that what appears before the onset of hayd counts as part of menstruation, while what appears after menstruation does not count as part of it.
